---
title: "check-one-function-per-file.yml"
---

Enforce the one-function-definition-per-file rule across repository code files
(`.R`, `.py`, `.sh`, `.js`, `.ts`, `.jl`).
The check scans code files to verify that each file defines at most one top-level
function, keeping code modular, searchable, and cleanly diffable.

Files that genuinely require multiple function definitions can opt out by adding
a comment directive near the top of the file:

```r
# check-one-function-per-file: allow-multiple
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | `'.'` | Target directory or file path to scan. |
| `paths-ignore` | string | `'.git, .github, tests, test, vendor, scratch, _site, node_modules, .pytest_cache, .venv, venv'` | Comma- or newline-separated paths or glob patterns to ignore. |
| `extensions` | string | `'.R, .r, .py, .sh, .bash, .js, .ts, .mjs, .cjs, .jl'` | Comma- or space-separated list of file extensions to check. |
| `opt-out-comment` | string | `''` | Optional custom comment string to treat as an opt-out directive. |
| `base-ref` | string | `''` | Git ref to diff against for diff-scoped checking (e.g. `origin/main`). On pull requests and pushes, defaults to `HEAD^1` (the base tip GitHub built the merge ref on) or the previous commit automatically for diff-scoping. |
| `fail` | boolean | `true` | Whether to fail the workflow if multiple function definitions are detected. |
| `python-version` | string | `'3.x'` | Python version to set up. |
| `runs-on` | string | `'ubuntu-latest'` | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it ([#1167](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167)). |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

## Example

```yaml
name: Check one function per file
on:
  push: { branches: [main] }
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-one-function-per-file.yml@v2
    # with:
    #   runs-on: private-runner  # self-hosted runner label (private repositories only)
```

See the
[`examples/`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/tree/main/examples)
directory for caller stubs (e.g. `examples/check-one-function-per-file.yml`).
